The [[Orrian Tome]] is a tome used by the [[Celestial Ministry]] to create [[Signet of Capture | Signets of Capture]] for the citizens of Kaineng Center (well, at least for those who can afford to pay for them).  From its name, one can assume that it came from the nation of [[Orr]], but how it came to be in the hands of the Celestial Ministry in Cantha is a mystery.  

==Acquisition==
Dropped by [[Am Fah Leader]] in [[The Undercity]].
